title: Chapter 201 Swimming Competition
content:
Chapter 201 Swimming Competition

Wang Shuo sent a soldier to walk on it for a while, and found that it could still bear one person walking, so he felt relieved.

"Everyone keep your distance and pass slowly." Considering the bearing capacity of the corridor, Wang Shuo left most of his soldiers on the shore.

Leaving Baili Liang to command the 20 soldiers on the shore, Wang Shuo stepped onto the corridor.

Everyone carefully kept a distance and groped towards the pavilion in the center of the lake.

After walking for a while, Wang Shuo finally saw the situation in the pavilion clearly.

A figure stood in it, but it was not very clear because of the mist and death.

When Wang Shuo and others stood on the corridor at the edge of the pavilion, she turned around.

Everyone was shocked.

This skeleton is very different from other skeletons.

First of all, she is not only a skeleton, but also a face.

It looks like a piece of human skin is glued on the skull.

It's just that her face is full of wrinkles and gullies, like an old witch.

She is wearing a water green dress, the color is no longer bright, and it is a little gray.

Her long hair was draped over her shoulders, and it looked like she had never washed it. It was all dry and tangled.

Wang Shuo immediately used the "Eye of Delusion Breaker".

[Xia Qi]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack: 200]

[Defense: 100]

[HP: 4000]

[Note: The princess's personal maid, she likes swimming, and is especially good at water dancing. She is deeply loved by the Black Dragon King and the princess. ]

She is not even a boss?

This made Wang Shuo a little suspicious.

"Are you here to swim with me?" A hoarse voice squeezed out of his face, harsh and unpleasant.

"Swim, you big-headed ghost, why would I swim with an old witch like you!" Wang Shuo looked ugly, and he was slandering in his heart.

Yellow-haired Locke raised his eyebrows and thought about it. He was very good at swimming, but he didn't know how to swim.

The other three women looked uglier, especially Ye Xueer, who was already the color of pig liver.

Similarly, Wang Shuo couldn't swim!

Before everyone agreed.

Xia Qi waved his palm like a dead branch, and two huge waves rolled up in the lake and hit everyone.

Everyone fell into the lake like dumplings.

The death aura in the lake was more intense than on land, and the lake water was freezing cold, and everyone couldn't stand it all of a sudden.

"Do you see the rockery in the distance? The first one to arrive wins!"

"Hey, is there any reward for the winner?" Locke asked loudly at the moment of falling into the water.

Several people sank to the bottom of the lake. Wang Shuo fluttered a few times and landed at the bottom of the lake. The bottom of his feet was not soft mud, but hard things like branches.

He put his armor and other weapons into his backpack and opened his eyes.

His heart was pounding.

Damn, the bottom of the lake is full of skeletons, some animal, some human, mainly human skeletons.

Wang Shuo was so scared that he quickly waved his hands and feet and jumped towards the water surface, but his skeleton was not solid. When he stepped on it, he sank into the mud. Wang Shuo did not use the power to move upward.

The lake water poured into his mouth and nose, making Wang Shuo terrified.

At this moment, Wang Shuo seemed to touch someone.

The person quickly hugged Wang Shuo tightly, like an octopus, with his hands around Wang Shuo's neck and his legs tightly clamped around his waist.

Wang Shuo barely opened his eyes and saw the person holding him in the dirty water.

It was Ye Xueer.

The double-layer clothes on her body were wet and clung to her graceful figure.

The placket on her chest was agitated by the lake water, opening and closing.

Wang Shuo felt his brain go blank.

Half of it was because his brain was filled with water.

The other half was because he had been single for so many years, and for the first time he felt being hugged by a girl in such a posture.
